Masterpiece Interface Workshop

How the workshop works

Every window, tab and menu of Masterpiece 0.10.0-dev is here, captured from the running program with its real controls, names and positions. Change anything, then export your proposal.

  1. Pick a window or menu in the list on the left.
  2. Move an element by dragging it. Drag its corners to resize it. Drag across empty space to select several. Arrow keys nudge by 1 px, with Shift by 10 px.
  3. Rename in the inspector on the right. A renamed text shows on a yellow marker.
  4. Delete with the Delete key or the inspector. Move to another window sends an element to any other window or tab.
  5. Cut out any part of a picture that is not an element yet, such as a heading drawn by the program, and it becomes movable.
  6. Add new controls, new windows and new menus. Line, Arrow, Frame and Note draw your explanations on top.
  7. Menus: rename, reorder, indent into submenus, move items between menus, add items and separators.
  8. Proposal details: give the proposal a title, your name and the idea behind it.
  9. Export proposal saves a ZIP: the XML definition of the whole interface, a list of the changes, and a picture of every changed window and menu with your drawings.

Your work stays in this browser as you go. Import brings an exported proposal back to continue it or to study someone else's.

Send your proposal as a reply in the interface overhaul discussion, with the ZIP attached.
